blocks.heading: Microsoft Teams cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Microsoft Teams against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Microsoft Teams Free until a gated capability (cloud phone (Microsoft Teams Free, Teams Phone Standard, Teams Calling Plan, Microsoft 365 Enterprise)) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (cloud phone, call routing, call recording) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Scored as a collaboration hub — Teams Phone is a telephony add-on, not the primary scored job. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

blocks.title: Microsoft Teams cost mistakes to avoid

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: Scored as a collaboration hub — Teams Phone is a telephony add-on, not the primary scored job

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Teams Phone requires an eligible Teams/M365 licence plus PSTN (PAYG or Calling Plan)

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: October 2023 Teams unbundling means Teams is not free inside every Microsoft 365 SKU

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: No power dialer; SMS and WhatsApp are not first-class customer channels

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Copilot AI is a separately priced Microsoft 365 add-on

blocks.body: Compare total cost of ownership vs Microsoft Teams on identical constraints.
